content: Brompheniramine is an anticholinergic medication that has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of hay fever (allergic rhinitis) and upper respiratory allergies. Common side effects include hypersensitivity reactions and drowsiness. Adult Indications and Dosage FDA-Labeled Indications and Dosage (Adult): Brompheniramine is used to temporarily relieve symptoms associated with hay fever or upper respiratory allergies, including: Runny nose Sneezing Itching of the nose or throat Itchy, watery eyes Off-Label Use and Dosage (Adult): There is limited information available regarding off-label, non-guideline-supported use of brompheniramine in adults. Pediatric Indications and Dosage FDA-Labeled Indications and Dosage (Pediatric): There is limited information available regarding FDA-labeled use of brompheniramine in pediatric patients. Off-Label Use and Dosage (Pediatric): Guideline-Supported Use: Limited information is available regarding off-label, guideline-supported use of brompheniramine in pediatric patients. Non-Guideline-Supported Use: Limited information is available regarding off-label, non-guideline-supported use of brompheniramine in pediatric patients. Contraindications Brompheniramine is contraindicated in individuals with hypersensitivity to any of its ingredients. Warnings Consult a doctor before use if you have: Breathing problems such as emphysema or chronic bronchitis Glaucoma Difficulty urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking sedatives or tranquilizers. When using this product: Excitability may occur, particularly in children. Drowsiness may occur. Avoid alcoholic beverages. Alcohol, sedatives, and tranquilizers may increase drowsiness. Use caution when driving or operating machinery. If pregnant or breastfeeding, consult a healthcare professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, seek medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately. Overdose may result in hallucinations, convulsions, or death. How Supplied Brompheniramine is supplied in a tight, light-resistant container with a child-resistant cap. It contains color additives, including FD&C Yellow No. 5 (tartrazine). Ala-Hist IR tablets are dark green, caplet-shaped, scored tablets debossed with Poly bisect 783 on one side and plain on the other. Storage Store at 15°-30°C (59°-86°F). Patient Counseling Information Precautions with Alcohol: The interaction between alcohol and brompheniramine has not been established. Patients should consult their doctor regarding the effects of consuming alcohol while taking this medication. Brand Names Brompheniramine is marketed under the brand name Ala-Hist IR®.
